description:
Save videos from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X and more — in HD, instantly, right to your device.

HD Video Downloads – Save videos in the highest available quality.

Copy the video link from any supported app
Open Social Video Saver and paste the link
Hit Download — done!
